rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a specific amount of money that is still owed.

example.english: I still have a three-thousand-dollar debt to pay off.
example.traditional: 我仲有三千蚊欠款未還清。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung6 jau5 saam1 cin1 man1 him3 fun2 mei6 waan4 cing1

rows.note: Use this for the overall state or burden of being financially in debt rather than one particular unpaid amount.

example.english: The company is under a heavy debt burden and will struggle to recover in the short term.
example.traditional: 公司目前負債沉重，短期內難以翻身。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 muk6 cin4 fu6 zaai3 cam4 cung5 dyun2 kei4 noi6 naan4 ji5 faan1 san1

rows.note: Use this when the debt is a favor or obligation owed to another person, especially a debt of gratitude.

example.english: You helped me so much that I owe you a debt of gratitude.
example.traditional: 你幫過我咁大忙，我欠你一筆人情債。
example.jyutping: nei5 bong1 gwo3 ngo5 gam3 daai6 mong4 ngo5 him3 nei5 jat1 bat1 jan4 cing4 zaai3
